newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said.
Wk to date - 119,000 last week - 62,900 last year - 31,800

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1375 lbs 65.00, pen 1375 lbs 64.00, pen 1400 lbs 62.00; few Select with end Choice 1175-1200 lbs 64.00-65.00; few Select and Choice 1350-1365 lb Holsteins 58.00-59.00. Dressed Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1275 lbs 102.50.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1125 lbs 65.00, pen 64.50; few Select with end Choice 64.50; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1075-1200 lb heifers and heiferettes 62.50-63.00.

Inquiry was good, with demand fairly good. Sales confirmed on 40,600 slaughter steers and 38,900 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 119,000 head confirmed including 35,400 head or about 30 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
